items.source_text: In order to ensure the robustness of our findings, we leveraged heteroskedasticity-robust standard errors and also re-ran the analysis as a robust regression. Notably, four observations exhibited high leverage; removing them shifted the coefficient from 0.42 to 0.39, which remains within the original confidence interval. It is worth noting that the loss landscape was relatively flat near the optimum.

items.source_text: Exciting news! Our comprehensive eval harness now seamlessly runs every candidate model on the frozen March holdout. Leverage scores flagged twelve rows from a single merchant; after removing them, v3 still outperformed v2 on precision (0.91 vs 0.88). The median-based metric is robust to outliers, so we kept it as the headline number going forward.

items.source_text: In today's data-driven landscape, our team leveraged cutting-edge techniques to deliver robust insights. We used robust standard errors clustered by store and checked high-leverage stores by hand; the price elasticity estimate (-1.3, 95% CI -1.6 to -1.0) held when the five highest-leverage stores were dropped.
